title: Fire dampers where a duct passes through a fire separation
summary: A fire damper where a duct penetrates a fire separation with a fire-resistance rating, Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1), with the exceptions in Sentences (2) to (5) and 9.10.5.1.(3).
review_note: Unreviewed: a domain reviewer has not yet signed the vectors for this rule (evals_dev/rules/REVIEW.md).

outcomes.message: This building has more than 3 storeys or a building area over 600 m², so Part 9 does not apply (Div A, Sentence 1.3.3.3.(1)). The Part 3 requirements are not checked here.
outcomes.assumption: Assumed a Part 9 building (3 storeys or less, building area 600 m² or less); the storeys or building area were not stated.

outcomes.message: No duct passes through a fire separation with a fire-resistance rating, so Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1) does not apply.

A fire damper is installed where the duct passes through the fire separation. This follows the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1); the damper's rating and installation (Articles 3.1.8.4. and 3.1.8.10.) are not checked here.
The duct serves commercial cooking equipment; Sentence 9.10.13.13.(5) does not require a fire damper at the fire separation. This follows the acceptable solution.

The noncombustible branch duct (melting point {duct_melting_point_c}, area {duct_area_cm2}, discharging {discharge_height_m} above the floor) meets each condition of Sentence 9.10.13.13.(2), so no fire damper is required. This follows the acceptable solution.

The noncombustible branch duct (melting point {duct_melting_point_c}) is carried {branch_carried_up_mm} up inside an exhaust riser under negative pressure, meeting Sentence 9.10.13.13.(3), so no fire damper is required. This follows the acceptable solution.

The noncombustible duct (melting point {duct_melting_point_c}, above 760 °C) exhausts directly outside at the top of the vertical service space, meeting Sentence 9.10.13.13.(4), so no fire damper is required. This follows the acceptable solution.
The opening is in a rated membrane ceiling, and the ducts, openings and protection follow Appendix D, which Sentence 9.10.5.1.(3) permits. This follows the acceptable solution.

There is no fire damper, and the branch duct does not meet every condition of Sentence 9.10.13.13.(2): noncombustible ({duct_noncombustible}), melting point not below 760 °C ({duct_melting_point_c}), cross-sectional area less than 130 cm² ({duct_area_cm2}), discharge not more than 1.2 m above the floor ({discharge_height_m}). The design departs from the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1).

There is no fire damper, and the branch duct does not meet every condition of Sentence 9.10.13.13.(3): noncombustible ({duct_noncombustible}), melting point not below 760 °C ({duct_melting_point_c}), carried up inside the riser not less than 500 mm ({branch_carried_up_mm}), riser under negative pressure ({riser_negative_pressure}). The design departs from the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1).

There is no fire damper, and the duct does not meet every condition of Sentence 9.10.13.13.(4): noncombustible ({duct_noncombustible}), melting point above 760 °C ({duct_melting_point_c}), exhausting directly outside at the top of the service space ({exhausts_outside_at_top}). The design departs from the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1).

There is no fire damper, and the openings in the rated membrane ceiling do not follow Appendix D as Sentence 9.10.5.1.(3) requires. The design departs from the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1).

A duct passes through a fire separation with a fire-resistance rating without a fire damper, and none of the exceptions in Sentences 9.10.13.13.(2) to (5) or 9.10.5.1.(3) fits it. The design departs from the acceptable solution in Sentence 9.10.13.13.(1).

not_checked: Articles 3.1.8.4. and 3.1.8.10.: the damper's rating and installation
Sentence 9.10.9.9.(5): firestopping around fire dampers (it does not remove the need for a damper)
